newsitem.title: USA: Expeditors opens eight new offices.
newsitem.headline: Expeditors opens eight new offices.

text.p: Expeditors International said it has opened eight new offices, including its first two in Indonesia and a UK office to serve the high tech industry.
The Indonesian offices, in Jakarta and Surabaya, will operate under the name P.T. Lancar Pratama Intercargo, it said.
The new UK office at Swindon will serve Britain's high tech industry clustered to the west of London, the company said.
Other new offices are in Nanjing,China as well as in Cape Town and Bombay.
Expeditors also said that Colombo-based Expeditors Lanka Pvt. Ltd. has become its exclusive agent for Sri Lanka.

In the U.S. the freight forwarder/logistics provider has opened offices in Norfolk, Virginia, next to the Port of Virginia, while the company's new Indianapolis office is located next to Indianapolis International Airport. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+-5017
